title: Time To Impeach LLM-as-a-Judge: Programs are the Future of Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing robustness by measuring consistency (stability of judging decisions) and biased response win rate (how frequently biases affect preferences) when the order of candidate answers is altered, using a dataset from Chen et al.
Measuring consistency and biased response win rate when evaluating responses that contain stereotypical or gender-preferential language.
Evaluating consistency and biased response win rate when candidate responses prioritize formatting over factual accuracy.
Measuring consistency and biased response win rate when evaluating responses that credit claims citing sources without providing evidence.
